notes.title: 2025 Plans
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

I'd like to announce a preview of things to come to [b]Legend of Crystal Valley[/b]:

For the past 2 years we've been slowly working on porting our old engine to modern platforms.
In the process of doing so, we released one of the games we made using the same engine that has been used for the Legend of Crystal Valley. The game is a platformer game for kids, called [b]"Tibor: Tale of a Kind Vampire"[/b], which was originally released in 2009.
Check it out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3285420/Tibor_Tale_of_a_Kind_Vampire/][b]here[/b][/url].

These games were made using 'Python' and 'Ogre3D engine' and now the old games run inside our newer engine which we use for most of our other games. Think of it as a sort of a 'virtual machine' for older games.

What this means in short term is that we are planning to port the Legend of Crystal Valley to this new engine. This will immediately bring the following benefits:
[list]
[*]The game's 3D models will look much sharper and will be anti-aliased, (no more hard edges)
[*]The game will work on MacOS and Linux
[/list]

This is just the beginning, the first step in a larger journey of remastering Legend of Crystal Valley. We have more plans to improve this game in 2025, stay tuned. 🙂

All of these upgrades, like the previous ones - are coming to you as a free update, no DLC and no "Deluxe" or "Remastered" Edition.

notes.title: Eve gets her say!
notes.content:
We're continuing our update streak for Legend of Crystal valley!

This time it's a big one: After many months of hard work, we're bringing English voiceovers to the game!
Originally, this game was released wihout any voiceovers because back then in 2009, we were a very small studio and just couldn't do it.
But today, things are very different and we feel an obligation to do right by the early games that launched our carrers in game development.

Though this game played fine without voices, we can all agree that voices make playing an adventure game a much more enjoyable experience.
The whole process was long and challenging but it was super-fun! We learned a lot and I think the end-result is quite nice!

We hope you give it a try and let us know what you think of the new addition.


This is not the end for Legend of Crystal Valley's 15th anniversary updates, oh no, not by a long shot! :)
Next on our agenda is bringing the game to MacOS and Linux! This will require some major changes in the game's engine though... We already have working prototypes so it's just a matter of doing the rest of the work and testing the game thoroughly. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Achievements added!
notes.content:
As we anounced in the previous update, we're doing a series of updates to enhance this game in order to celebrate its 15th birthday!

This time we've added support for Steam achievements and have made 25 of them!
You'll only get a handful of achievements while playing regularly, the rest are carefully hidden throught the game, some are easy to guess while some may be tougher to find :)
Write us in the discussion forums if you get stuck, and we'll drop hints to help you out.

Quite a few achievements are centered on various easter eggs we hid in the game, it was very fun revisting them all and we hope you'll enjoy them too!

There are more updates on the way and will be released in the coming months.

Enjoy the game and happy hunting :)

notes.title: New Languages added + Steam Cloud
notes.content:
This year Legend of Crystal Valley celebrates it's 15th birthday!
So for this ocasion, we decided to give the game a well deserved overhaul!
And best of all, this is just the first of a series of improvements we have lined up for Legend of Crystal Valley in the coming months, so stay tuned.

What's new:
1) This version adds several new languages
[olist]
[*] Italian (Texts + Voiceovers!)
[*] Polish
[*] Russian
[*] Croatian
[/olist]
(These are now all the languages Legend of Crystal Valley has been translated in so far)

2) The game now has 2 sets of voiceovers: German and Italian, and now you can freely choose one of them in all languages supported in the game. Italian sounds particularily awesome in our opinion!

3) The German version is no longer a separate build on Steam, all languages are now integrated in one build. English is the default and you can choose another language by manually clicking the language button in the lower left corner of the main menu. Automatic language detection from Steam is scheduled for the next update.

4) Croatian language is now available! We're from Croatia and in 2009 we partnered with a local newspaper company to distribute Legend of Crystal Valley in stores as a retail CD. It was translated to Croatian and was quite an achievement for us back then. This language is now restored and integrated in the game for all you nostalgic Croats!

5) The tutorial is back. Though the game originally had a tutorial, it caused problems for the Steam version so we disabled it. It's now fixed and translated to all supported languages. English and Russian tutorials have voiceovers as well.

6) Anti-aliasing now works again. It's disabled by default though.

7) Last but not least - the game now has support for steam cloud save syncing!
However, to get this to work, we had to change the location where the game saves data, so if you have been playing the game before the update, the new version won't load your previous progress. Go to the discussion forums, we posted a guide how to transfer your saved files to the new version.

8) And just to be on the safe side, the old build is available as a beta branch on steam, so if for some reason the new build is giving you trouble, you can use the old one while we investigate. If you run into trouble, please write in the discussion forum so we may fix it.

That's it from us, we hope you like the changes, give it a go and let us know what you think.


And a sneak preview for the next update which is coming in a week or two - due to popular demand, we are adding Steam Achievements in the game!
